welcome_page.title: Motorcycle and scooter – When your motorcycle is hard to replace
welcome_page.description:
Some trips are hard to make without your motorcycle or scooter. Tell us which ones.

Taking part is voluntary and you can skip any question. Your answers are not linked to your name, and no public authority receives them.

Learn more about SmartUrbanity

Only the SmartUrbanity research team reads your answers. We keep them for research for 36 months; then we delete them or make them anonymous.

questions.text: What do you use your motorcycle or scooter for? (Select all that apply)

options.text: Travelling at night or getting to night shifts, when public transport is scarce
Getting around because my area is poorly served by public transport
Being sure of getting back, even after many hours
Making unexpected trips, even out of town

questions.text: If there were a reliable alternative for these trips, would you use your motorcycle or scooter less?
